✂️ CapCut Editing · Lesson 3 of 3

Reusable Formats Without the Template Button

5 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

That "post a template" button you've seen on CapCut? It's restricted to approved template creators, and most people never get it. The real professional shortcut is far simpler, and it's free.

Re-making the same styling decisions on every video is what makes editing feel slow. You pick a font. You find the right size. You remember where captions go. Every single time. The fix isn't a fancy feature; it's turning your best project into a starting point.

Method 1: Duplicate your best project

  1. Finish a video you're happy with: captions styled, intro and outro set, music at the right volume.
  2. Go to your projects list, open the project's menu (the three dots) and choose Duplicate.
  3. Rename the copy, e.g. MASTER_salon_tip.
  4. For each new video, duplicate MASTER, swap in new clips and edit the text. Style, positions and export settings are already done.

Method 2: Save text styles and favourites

When you style a caption you love, look in the text style panel for an option to save it or add it to favourites. The label moves between updates. Do the same for effects and transitions you use often by tapping the star or favourite icon.

💡 Why your template button is missing

CapCut's help centre says posting templates is limited to approved creators, the option doesn't appear until you're approved, and posting generally isn't supported on the web version. Don't waste an evening hunting for a button you don't have. A duplicated master project gives you 90% of the benefit for your own channel.

What to lock in your master projectWhy it saves time
Caption font, size, colour and positionThe decision you'd otherwise make 50 times a month
A 1–2 second intro or sign-offMakes videos recognisably yours
Music volume levelNo more guessing if the music drowns your voice
Export settings (9:16, 1080p)No accidental 720p uploads
Placeholder text for price and contactYou'll never forget "KES ___ / WhatsApp ___" again
✗ MYTH

Saving your project in CapCut's cloud means only you can ever use it.

✓ REALITY

CapCut's June 2025 terms grant it a broad, worldwide licence to content you upload to its services, as reported by TechRadar. CapCut says the licence is only as far as needed to run the service. Practical takeaway: keep confidential client footage and unreleased product photos as local drafts, and back up your master files to your own phone or drive.

📋 Master project naming system
MASTER_[CONTENT TYPE]_[PLATFORM]
Example: MASTER_pricevideo_tiktok

New videos: [YYMMDD]_[TOPIC]_v1
Example: 261104_knotless_price_v1

After posting, add a note in the project name if it beat your average: 261104_knotless_price_WIN
✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

Why can't most creators find the option to post a CapCut template?

CapCut's help centre says template posting is limited to approved creators, and the option doesn't show until you're approved. Duplicating a master project gives you a reusable format without needing approval.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. Template posting is for approved creators only.
  2. Duplicate a MASTER project to reuse your best format.
  3. Save text styles and favourite effects once, reuse forever.
  4. Keep sensitive footage local; read CapCut's content licence.
